skill.name: Collect Field CLS Attribution Data
skill.description: Instrument production applications with web-vitals library attribution functions or equivalent RUM provider APIs to gather detailed Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) metrics from real user sessions, including element identifiers, shift timing, and user context for pattern analysis.
skill.skill_body:
Instrument your production application with the web-vitals library's attribution functions or equivalent RUM provider APIs to collect CLS metrics from real user sessions. Capture element identifiers, shift timing, and user context. Aggregate and analyze the collected data to identify patterns in layout shift causes and frequency across your user base.

## Objective

Production CLS data collection and attribution
## Applicable Signals

- Production traffic available for instrumentation
- RUM infrastructure or web-vitals library integration possible
- Need for attribution-level CLS insights beyond lab measurements

## Contraindications

- Performing lab-based diagnosis using DevTools or Lighthouse
- Testing in development or staging environments without production traffic
- RUM infrastructure not available or not deployable
- Privacy constraints preventing collection of user interaction data

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Integrate web-vitals library or RUM provider with attribution support into production application'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Configure attribution functions to capture element identifiers and timing information for each layout shift'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Collect CLS metrics along with user context (session ID, user segment, page type) from production sessions'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Aggregate collected data in your analytics or monitoring backend'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Analyze patterns to identify which elements and scenarios cause the most significant layout shifts'}

## Constraints

- Requires web-vitals library or compatible RUM provider with attribution support
- Must have production deployment capability
- Data collection must comply with privacy and consent policies
- Attribution data collection adds minimal overhead to user sessions

## Cautions

- Ensure user consent and privacy compliance before collecting field data
- Monitor instrumentation overhead to avoid impacting page performance
- Aggregate data appropriately to protect individual user privacy

## Output Contract

- Collected field CLS metrics with attribution data including element identifiers, shift timing, and user context aggregated from production sessions; ready for analysis and correlation with user behavior patterns
